# Historical long-ticket calibration — blind-review results

Date: 2026-09-03. Active work ticket: inanimate-unrideable-wasp (ee2e-6fec-aa8a-4e77).

## Review protocol

Three independent background reviewers each read eight complete compiled tickets through rebar MCP: two shared calibration tickets plus six disjoint tickets. Reviewers received the preservation-first definitions and exemptions for R1–R10 but not detector outputs. They labeled overall bloat and each rule's targeted construct as present/absent/NA with evidence and confidence. The sample has 20 unique tickets: ten descriptions at 7,200–7,999 characters, ten at >=8,000; five each of bug, epic, story, and task. Selection seed and complete batch assignments are recorded on the active ticket.

Ground truth uses each unique reviewer's label, with primary-agent adjudication of the shared items. cibophobic-moist-guineafowl was unanimously appropriate with every targeted construct absent. uncheered-sombre-bumblebee split 1 bloated versus 2 appropriate; R2 and R9 were the only split rule labels. Adjudication: appropriate / R2 absent / R9 absent, medium confidence, because the repeated names and mappings trace distinct CLI/library/MCP contracts and acceptance tests; the dissent that these could be consolidated remains material uncertainty.

Agreement evidence is deliberately limited: 1/2 shared tickets was unanimous overall; 5/6 overall judgments matched the adjudicated result (83.3%); 18/20 shared ticket×rule labels were unanimous (90%), with R2 and R9 on uncheered-sombre-bumblebee split 1–2. The other 18 tickets are single-labeled.

## Per-ticket adjudicated labels

- cibophobic-moist-guineafowl / b928-3ab6-5985-417b — appropriate, high: incident RCA, deployed identities, live validation, hashes, and close evidence are audit/recovery state.
- uncheered-sombre-bumblebee / f789-3f9d-8b35-4e0d — appropriate, medium: large three-surface compatibility contract; one reviewer found material cross-section repetition.
- exultant-neofascist-bluegill / 1e88-687f-45d1-435f — appropriate, high: controlled provider experiments and corrected causal conclusions prevent repeated diagnosis.
- outrageous-uncultured-wildebeast / 0e68-41eb-5782-4336 — bloated, high: an archived 10,523-character original description republishes the condensed current plan.
- amenable-befuddling-phoenix / 2e0f-e4dc-ee9d-4855 — appropriate, medium: complex polyglot detector contract; one dense approach item has local sprawl.
- coyish-fluent-gibbon / e7a9-35fa-1d58-4095 — appropriate, high: credential-leak incident and no-echo/security evidence are necessary.
- dissimilar-sorcerous-hartebeest / 3393-83ca-5501-4e6e — bloated, medium: reimports its cited design-of-record, repeats security guarantees, and retains incomplete AC fragments.
- punctual-scavenger-fallowdeer / 2682-b015-4fe5-4066 — appropriate, medium: safe module extraction needs measured dependency, cycle, and dynamic-reference evidence.
- camerashy-erectable-frog / 301d-0769-ed02-42f6 — appropriate, medium: lock-safety contract is proportionate; one dense mechanism paragraph is locally sprawling.
- spin-cub-usher / 65dd-e93b-666a-4caa — appropriate, high: corpus predicates, budget, exclusions, validity, and child ownership are executable inputs; no comments.
- synonymous-senatorial-cuscus / 6e2f-2814-4f92-4873 — appropriate, high: irreversible cleanup requires exact Jira IDs, leases, digests, custody, rollback, and forensic disposition.
- strained-bare-turnstone / df2c-e4b8-496d-4698 — appropriate, high: reproduced seven-layer failure chain and strict-superset resolution are load-bearing.
- elfish-chair-lug / 88ab-7052-8850-46d4 — appropriate, medium: unusually broad feature-branch epic justifies architecture, six-story decomposition, and seven live scenarios; some criteria sprawl.
- enduring-cagophilic-orca / 1de3-a19f-c4ea-4b28 — bloated, high: a small dead-Protocol deletion repeats test/absence requirements across four sections.
- picky-censorable-loon / 69e3-748d-0274-45f3 — appropriate, medium: one superseded checklist repeats locally, but the six-shard 439-file audit remains proportionate.
- sepia-cardiac-hawk / ddcd-fc9e-a81f-4cbb — appropriate, high: DCO policy, migration, rollback, automation, and live acceptance/rejection proof are required.
- blousy-luxuriant-rasbora / ce7d-3a15-51e5-4c6a — bloated, medium: a narrow five-file guidance change repeats the same matrix, scope, tests, and exclusions.
- jira-reb-1003 — appropriate, medium: a four-child criterion epic owns coaching, calibration, dependency, and regression contracts.
- stew-kid-motif / 6a9a-910a-6938-4695 — bloated, high: three appended remediation/AC blocks restate the same dotted-ID mapping and call sites.
- lofty-beech-twang / a118-fa8e-547a-49ba — bloated, high: retains superseded assumptions and appends repeated remediation/AC sections instead of one current plan.

Overall: 6/20 bloated (30%); 14/20 appropriate (70%). This is prevalence only in the deliberately enriched near/over-limit sample, not the full ticket population.

## Deterministic implementation used

The frozen calibration-v1 detector is Markdown-aware and read-only. It normalizes case, whitespace, and list markers for comparison; excludes fenced code, quotations, headings, and tables from prose-only checks; protects exact identifiers by retaining their tokens; treats typed correction/resolution/handoff comments as R2 exemptions; applies the published numeric thresholds literally; and reports ticket-level firing when any eligible artifact fires. R9 uses fallback thresholds because no versioned type×complexity P95 bucket exists. R10 compares cited files in the current checkout with rolling 100-word windows; it cannot reconstruct historical file revisions or linked ticket/session-log sources. The temporary detector was removed after the run; no repository file was retained.

## Confusion matrices

Percentages are of each rule's applicable denominator. NA is excluded.

| Rule | N | NA | TP | FP | FN | TN | Precision | Recall | Specificity |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| R1 exact duplication | 20 | 0 | 1 (5.0%) | 1 (5.0%) | 1 (5.0%) | 17 (85.0%) | 50.0% | 50.0% | 94.4% |
| R2 near/history duplication | 20 | 0 | 0 (0%) | 0 (0%) | 4 (20.0%) | 16 (80.0%) | undefined | 0% | 100% |
| R3 transcript dump | 20 | 0 | 0 (0%) | 0 (0%) | 0 (0%) | 20 (100%) | undefined | undefined | 100% |
| R4 empty update | 17 | 3 | 0 (0%) | 0 (0%) | 0 (0%) | 17 (100%) | undefined | undefined | 100% |
| R5 filler/meta | 20 | 0 | 0 (0%) | 0 (0%) | 0 (0%) | 20 (100%) | undefined | undefined | 100% |
| R6 sentence/paragraph sprawl | 20 | 0 | 6 (30.0%) | 14 (70.0%) | 0 (0%) | 0 (0%) | 30.0% | 100% | 0% |
| R7 alternatives/hedges | 20 | 0 | 0 (0%) | 0 (0%) | 0 (0%) | 20 (100%) | undefined | undefined | 100% |
| R8 imperative saturation | 20 | 0 | 0 (0%) | 0 (0%) | 2 (10.0%) | 18 (90.0%) | undefined | 0% | 100% |
| R9 length envelope | 20 | 0 | 5 (25.0%) | 13 (65.0%) | 0 (0%) | 2 (10.0%) | 27.8% | 100% | 13.3% |
| R10 canonical copying | 19 | 1 | 0 (0%) | 0 (0%) | 2 (10.5%) | 17 (89.5%) | undefined | 0% | 100% |

R4 NA: spin-cub-usher, picky-censorable-loon, stew-kid-motif had no eligible comments. R10 NA: enduring-cagophilic-orca's cited deleted source was unavailable at the current revision.

Rule-specific errors:
- R1 TP outrageous-uncultured-wildebeast; FP coyish-fluent-gibbon (necessary security repetition); FN picky-censorable-loon (superseded-checklist repeat).
- R2 FN outrageous-uncultured-wildebeast, enduring-cagophilic-orca, stew-kid-motif, lofty-beech-twang.
- R6 fires on every ticket; its six positives are amenable-befuddling-phoenix, camerashy-erectable-frog, dissimilar-sorcerous-hartebeest, elfish-chair-lug, enduring-cagophilic-orca, and lofty-beech-twang.
- R8 FN stew-kid-motif and lofty-beech-twang because semantic emphasis used forms beyond literal MUST/ALWAYS/NEVER or remained below density.
- R9 correctly finds all five targeted length positives but also fires on 13 appropriate records.
- R10 FN dissimilar-sorcerous-hartebeest (linked ticket/session-log design source) and blousy-luxuriant-rasbora (source revision/section-copy mismatch).

Union-of-rules versus overall bloat: TP 6 (30%), FP 14 (70%), FN 0, TN 0; precision 30%, recall 100%, specificity 0%. Every ticket fired because R6 fired on all 20, so a naive OR is unusable.

No-positive caveat: R3, R4, R5, and R7 saw only negatives. Their 100% observed TN rates measure this sample's specificity only; sensitivity and precision are unknown.
